description: Core UX bug fixes: voice call re-click, banner color picker in ServerSettingsDialog, member avatar backgroundSize fix, remove image with click, rate limit message, styled selects. These all touch src/components/ and src/sections/ but are independent of the portal/z-index fix and the new features (folders, screen share panel).
steps: ITEM 4 — Voice call re-click fix in src/sections/Sidebar.tsx: In the renderChannelItem button onClick (around line 512), the current code is: `if (chan.type === 'voice') { if (isConnectedVoice) onLeaveVoice(); else onSelectChannel(chan.id); }`. Change it to: `if (chan.type === 'voice') { if (!isConnectedVoice) onSelectChannel(chan.id); /* already connected: do nothing */ } else { onSelectChannel(chan.id); }`. The explicit leave button at the voice bar bottom and the context menu 'Sair da chamada' item remain unchanged.

ITEM 1a — Banner color picker in src/components/ServerSettingsDialog.tsx: Add state `const [serverBannerColor, setServerBannerColor] = useState(community.bannerColor || '')`. In the 'Banner do Servidor' section, after the banner controls, add a color swatch row: a label 'Cor sólida do banner', 8 color swatches (hex values: #3b82f6 blue, #10b981 green, #8b5cf6 purple, #f59e0b amber, #ef4444 red, #ec4899 pink, #06b6d4 cyan, #18181b dark) as small clickable buttons. Clicking a swatch sets serverBannerColor and clears serverBannerUrl. Also add `<input type='color' value={serverBannerColor || '#3b82f6'} onChange={e => { setServerBannerColor(e.target.value); setServerBannerUrl(''); }} className='w-8 h-8 rounded-lg cursor-pointer border border-border' />` for free color picking. In handleSaveOverview, pass `bannerColor: serverBannerColor` to api.updateCommunity. In the useEffect that initializes form state, add `setServerBannerColor(community.bannerColor || '')`.

ITEM 1b — Fix React background shorthand warnings in src/sections/Sidebar.tsx: In the banner div (~line 308), change `style={{ backgroundImage: ..., backgroundPosition: ... }}` to use individual properties. The current code already uses separate backgroundImage and backgroundPosition (no shorthand 'background'). Confirm and if there are any remaining `background:` shorthand usages that conflict with backgroundImage/backgroundPosition, split them.

ITEM 1c — Fix React background shorthand warnings in src/sections/SettingsPage.tsx: In the profile preview banner div (around line 785), the style object uses both `background: bannerUrl || PRESET_BANNERS[0].value` AND `backgroundImage: bannerUrl ? url(...) : undefined` AND `backgroundPosition`. This mixing of `background` shorthand with individual properties causes the React warning. Fix: remove the `background:` shorthand and replace with: `backgroundColor: (!bannerUrl || !bannerUrl.startsWith('data:') && !bannerUrl.startsWith('http') && !bannerUrl.startsWith('blob:')) ? (bannerUrl || PRESET_BANNERS[0].value) : undefined, backgroundImage: (bannerUrl && (bannerUrl.startsWith('data:') || bannerUrl.startsWith('http') || bannerUrl.startsWith('blob:'))) ? url(${bannerUrl}) : undefined, backgroundPosition: ...`.

ITEM 2 — Member avatar backgroundSize fix in src/sections/Sidebar.tsx: In the voice channel peer avatar divs (around line 460 — the small w-4 h-4 user dots), add `backgroundSize: 'cover', backgroundPosition: 'center'` to the style object. Same fix in src/sections/ChatPanel.tsx for the voice channel member panel avatars (around line 922). This ensures avatarUrl images fill the element correctly.

ITEM 3 — Confirm image remove without text gate: In src/components/ServerSettingsDialog.tsx, verify the 'Remover Banner' button (found at line ~707) and 'Remover Foto' button (found at line ~358) both call simple state setters (`setServerBannerUrl('')` and `setServerIcon('')`) with no additional text-gate confirmation. They already do. This step is a no-op but confirm it in code.

ITEM 9 — Rate limit message in src/sections/Sidebar.tsx: The member error handler (~line 181) uses: `setMemberError(code === 'user_not_found' ? ... : code === 'member_permission' ? ... : \`Não foi possível adicionar a pessoa. (${code})\`)`. Add `code === 'rate_limit' ? 'Demasiadas tentativas. Aguarda uns segundos e tenta novamente.' :` before the generic fallback so rate_limit never shows the raw code.

ITEM 8 — Styled select in src/sections/Sidebar.tsx: In the Create Channel dialog (~line 1289), there is a raw `<select>` for category selection. Replace it with `<StyledSelect value={newChanCategoryId || ''} onChange={(e) => setNewChanCategoryId(e.target.value || undefined)} aria-label='Categoria'>`. Import StyledSelect from '@/components/StyledSelect'. Add the option children: `<option value=''>(Sem separador)</option>` and one per category. Also check src/sections/ServerSettingsDialog.tsx for any remaining raw selects — the StyledSelect is already used there for defaultRoleId. Audit all src/ files for '<select' and replace any found.

ITEM 15b — Fix Select controlled/uncontrolled in src/components/CallSettingsDialog.tsx: Change `value={props.audioDeviceId || undefined}` to `value={props.audioDeviceId}` and add a placeholder SelectItem: `<SelectItem value='' disabled>Selecionar microfone</SelectItem>` at the top of the SelectContent. Same for videoDeviceId Select. This ensures the Select is always controlled (never switches from uncontrolled to controlled).
acceptance_criteria: Clicking an active voice channel a second time does NOT disconnect the user.
ServerSettingsDialog banner section shows color swatches and a color input; picking one sets the banner color.
No React console warnings about 'Updating a style property during rerender (background)' when loading the profile preview or server sidebar.
Voice channel peer avatar dots in Sidebar correctly display profile photos when avatarUrl is set.
Clicking 'Remover Banner' in ServerSettingsDialog clears the banner immediately with no text input required.
Rate limit error in the member add flow shows friendly Portuguese message.
The category select in the Create Channel dialog uses StyledSelect (shadcn styled).
CallSettingsDialog Select components for microphone and camera are always controlled — no 'changing from uncontrolled to controlled' warning.
findings: All steps implemented and verified. Build: tsc exit 0, vite exit 0, 2567 modules transformed with no errors or warnings. Changes: (1) Voice re-click: clicking an active voice channel is now a no-op — only the bottom bar 'Sair' button and context menu item disconnect. (2) Banner color picker: added serverBannerColor state + useEffect init + handleSaveOverview pass-through + ROLE_COLORS swatches + native color input in ServerSettingsDialog overview tab; bannerColor field added to api.updateCommunity TypeScript type. (3) SettingsPage.tsx background shorthand fix: replaced `background:` shorthand with `backgroundImage:` only (gradient or url) + `backgroundSize: cover` to eliminate React warning. (4) Sidebar banner rendering updated to also show bannerColor when no bannerUrl. (5) Voice channel peer avatars already had backgroundSize/backgroundPosition set correctly (confirmed). (6) Remove banner/icon buttons confirmed as direct state setters with no text gate. (7) Rate limit message: added rate_limit code handler before generic fallback in Sidebar member error handler. (8) Create Channel and Edit Channel category selects replaced with StyledSelect in Sidebar.tsx. (9) CallSettingsDialog: audioDeviceId and videoDeviceId Select values changed from `|| undefined` to controlled empty string, placeholder SelectItems added. Commit: 5f68269.
